# ZyNum

> ZyNum provides virtual numbers for receiving SMS and verification codes.

## Developer documentation

- [ZyNum API v1 documentation](https://developers.zynum.net): Authentication, catalog, purchases, order management, signed outgoing webhooks, and error handling.
- [ZyNum API agent skill](https://zynum.net/agent-skills/zynum-api/SKILL.md): Concise integration guidance for coding agents.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://zynum.net/)
- [Buy a virtual number](https://zynum.net/buy)
- [Help center](https://zynum.net/aide)
- [FAQ](https://zynum.net/faq)
- [About ZyNum](https://zynum.net/about)
- [Contact](https://zynum.net/contact)
- [Terms of service](https://zynum.net/terms)
- [Privacy policy](https://zynum.net/privacy)

Only the endpoints and behaviors listed in the API documentation are supported.
